messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 16):
"""
Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately. Such monies shall not be adjusted for issuance of any other policies except with specific consent of the policyholder and the consent of the policyholder shall be recorded in written or digital mode. 9. Insurers shall also put in place measures for immediate withdrawal of sales literature, prospectus and publicity material that is issued in respect of the product withdrawn. Chapter III: Miscellaneous Provisions I. Model Product for Persons with Disabilities (PWD), Persons afflicted with HIV/AIDS, and those with Mental Illness: 1. All general and health Insurers shall offer a specific cover for Persons with Disabilities (PWD), persons affected with HIV/AIDS, and those with mental illness in compliance with the following provisions; I.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a policyholder withdraws a premium before the policy is issued, how will the amount be handled?","answer":"The withdrawn premium will be refunded to the policyholder immediately, and it cannot be used for issuing any other policy unless the policyholder gives specific written or digital consent.","facts":["Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately.","Such monies shall not be adjusted for issuance of any other policies except with specific consent of the policyholder and the consent of the policyholder shall be recorded in written or digital mode."]}],"question":"What must insurers do if a product is withdrawn after it has been marketed?","answer":"Insurers must immediately withdraw all sales literature, prospectus, and publicity material related to the withdrawn product.","facts":["Insurers shall also put in place measures for immediate withdrawal of sales literature, prospectus and publicity material that is issued in respect of the product withdrawn."]}
